2.2. bool_expression_parser.parse¶

Provides functions for parsing boolean expressions.

Functions

parse(expression[, neg_sym, and_sym, …]) Parse a boolean expression.

Classes

BoolAnd(args) Represents the boolean AND operator.
BoolBinOp(args) Represents a boolean binary operator.
BoolExpr Base class for boolean expressions.
BoolFalse() The constant false.
BoolNot(arg) Represents the boolean NOT operator.
BoolOperand(label) Represents an operand in a boolean expression.
BoolOr(args) Represents the boolean OR operator.
